strategy.name: V11 CORE + A$100K FIXED SAFE FLOOR + BEST-NET EXECUTION
strategy.objective: Maximise sustainable accepted cash profit per year, not bet count.
strategy.rule: Keep frozen V11 core selections and stakes before verified actual FY cash reaches A$100K. At A$100K, protect a fixed A$100K floor and release only rounded-down verified profit cushion above that floor after accepted open exposure. Continue to require BET LOCKED, the live price floor and the A$10,000 hard cap.
strategy.selectionChange: NO PREDICTIVE SELECTION CHANGE. The ~65-bet 30% expansion has been demoted to SHADOW ONLY after chronological testing showed materially worse downside and weaker recent performance.

execution.message: The stored V11 start-around-10-Aug replay falls by about A$27.1K/year when winning prices are 5% worse. Real accepted price and fill quality remain one of the largest practical profit levers.

liveAudit.note: 2026 running totals are sourced from the immutable BET_LOCKED ledger. Once BET NOW exists, the event cannot be edited/deleted, the race state cannot be deleted, signal horse/stake/price are restored from the original lock, and future NO BET alerts are forbidden for that race. Signal P/L is not confirmed bookmaker cash P/L.

notificationAudit.note: The 29 Aug signal predates the current push ledger. All five later BET NOW push races match an immutable BET_LOCKED race. One historical Sep 26 race received a duplicate BET NOW push; build 1.11.23 prevents duplicate BET NOW pushes.

safeFloor.stressLabel: 5% central winning-price stress · fixed A$100K floor
safeFloor.note: Same historical V11 path and 5% execution-stress convention. The fixed floor keeps first reaching A$100K unchanged versus V3.7 but retains more post-target expected profit. These are research replays, not guaranteed bookmaker cash.

previousPolicy.name: V3.7 25% rising protected floor
previousPolicy.note: V3.7 was smoother but gave up about A$9.6K/year of 5%-stress historical mean versus the fixed A$100K safe floor.

challenger.name: 30% non-core Australian expansion
challenger.warning: REJECTED FOR LIVE PROMOTION. The headline ~65.4 bets/year / 47.9% / A$253.2K figures are hindsight-selected. Chronological testing increased historical average dollars but produced materially worse drawdown, a losing FY and weaker recent performance. Track it only as shadow research.

evidence.planningNotPromise: Historical averages and safe-floor planning means are model-equivalent research, not guaranteed accepted-cash income.
evidence.cashRule: Actual banked profit must use accepted stake, accepted price, bookmaker/exchange charges and settlement.
evidence.desktopBoundary: The phone app now shows the preferred fixed-safe-floor policy. The separate desktop package still needs the matching post-A$100K policy update before relying on it automatically. Before A$100K, frozen V11 selection/staking is unchanged.
